title: Position Target/Stop Tracking Guides
changes: Selected long/short positions display two non-interactive full-width horizontal dashed price guides for target (green) and stop (red).
During drag of a target or stop handle, dashed guides and price/percent badges derive from the exact same live log-scale price coordinates and move together; deselection removes guides.
No changes to market feeds, 10-second derived indicator refresh, chart navigation, risk calculations, RR, Signal Spotlight, R2 or Worker.
requiredDeploy: GitHub Pages only; Cloudflare Worker and R2 endpoints unchanged.
